title: Tiki Tiki
blurb: Nonsense with a rhythm engineered, seemingly deliberately, to lodge in your auditory cortex and refuse eviction. TikTok specialises in this exact genre — sounds that spread for no reason beyond being enjoyable to repeat — and this is a textbook case: it means nothing, does nothing, and cannot be got rid of by ordinary means. The repetition does something to the stress pattern that your brain treats as a hook. Resistance is available in theory and ineffective in practice. Play it at anybody who claims to be immune to earworms.
origin: A viral nonsense chant from TikTok.
